supporting_evidence.quote: Sales increased 12% in Q3 2026, and 16% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the comparable prior year periods.

input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Amazon's net sales for Q3 2026 (quarter ended September 30, 2026) increased by more than 10% year over year. Evidence E5 directly states "Sales increased 12% in Q3 2026...compared to the comparable prior year periods." Since 12% is greater than 10%, the claim is supported. The evidence clearly refers to the same period (Q3 2026 ending September 30, 2026) and provides the year-over-year growth rate for net sales.
